cohort: The study included 29,013 patients with newly diagnosed PIH between January 1, 2000, and December 31, 2013, selected from the Taiwan National Health Insurance Research Database (NHIRD) and 116,052 matched controls without PIH.
finding: Patients with a history of PIH were found to be at an increased risk of having infants who develop neonatal candidiasis compared to those without PIH, with preterm birth also being identified as an independent risk factor.
